name: TwoTrees TTS-55 20W
tagline: 20W Ultra-budget diode with surprising build quality for the price
tldr: TwoTrees TTS-55 20W is the 20W SKU on the TwoTrees twotrees tts 55 line. TwoTrees undercuts Atomstack and Ortur on price while offering a usable 5. Verify optical power on the listing: do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Everyday engraving plus reliable light cutting on wood, leather, and dark acrylic

Software on the profile: trial your workflow on scrap before production

beginnerNotes: This profile is the 20W SKU on TwoTrees TTS-55. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Use air assist for cuts, lower scan speed for photo engraving. Multiple passes at moderate speed beat one aggressive pass. Check the flagship tier’s cut benchmark if you quote production times to customers.

editorialDepth.advantages: TwoTrees TTS-55 20W is the versatile hobby / side-business SKU: clean engraving and light wood or leather cuts with comparable benchmarks on Maker Atlas.
editorialDepth.limitations: Open-frame: glasses and exhaust required. Upgrade path to 40W if cutting takes over. Not a CO₂ replacement for clear acrylic or heavy thick-stock production.
